        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIn" name="Log in to account" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Split" name="Parallel split (select items & set payment)" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectReward" name="Select reward option" />

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="Parallel join" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Installment" name="Complete installment agreement" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Deliver" name="Deliver items" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReturnDecision" name="Return items?" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Return" name="Return items for exchange" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="End" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_LogIn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Gateway_Split" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Task_SelectItems" targetRef="Gateway_RewardChoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" name="option" sourceRef="Gateway_RewardChoice" targetRef="Task_SelectReward" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_SelectReward" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentDecision" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" name="pay" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentDecision" targetRef="Task_Pay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" name="installment" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentDecision" targetRef="Task_Installment" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Task_Deliver" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Task_Installment" targetRef="Task_Deliver" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="Task_Deliver" targetRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F15" name="return" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" targetRef="Task_Return" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F16" name="no return" sourceRef="Gateway_ReturnDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F17" sourceRef="Task_Return" targetRef="Task_Deliver" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
